description: Defines a template class StreamJSONOneShotType for streaming JSON data with a one-shot parse approach, including internal serializer and deserializer implementations, and a handler class for data transmission. It is a specialized variant of StreamJSONType designed to avoid infinite loops caused by malformed JSON data.

classes.name: StreamJSONOneShotType
classes.description: A template class for one-shot streaming of JSON or MessagePack data, with internal serializer/deserializer and a handler for data transmission.

classes.name: SerializerImpl
classes.description: Handles serialization of outgoing data, managing a queue and locking.

classes.name: DeserializerImpl
classes.description: Handles deserialization of incoming data, parsing buffers into JSON/MessagePack objects.

classes.name: HandlerType
classes.description: A handler class inheriting from SOURCE, forwarding data and state change events to the parent.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits an element for transmission if the channel is open.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the communication channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the communication channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the channel is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the channel is closed.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the channel is suspended.
